name: smart-ambulance
description: Smart Emergency Ambulance Dispatch System - real-time ambulance dispatch, tracking and hospital coordination

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @sas/backend && npm run build --workspace @sas/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @sas/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
